summary: From 1 November 2026, uniform series NOTAMs for EGPX and EGTT will be issued as Quebec series.
text:
UNIFORM SERIES NOTAM THAT HAVE AN EFFECTIVE DATE OF 01 NOV 26 OR 
BEYOND WILL BE ISSUED AS A QUEBEC SERIES. AIC Y100/26 DATED 17 SEP 
WILL REFER. ADDRESSES THAT RECEIVE A UNIFORM SERIES NOTAM WILL BE 
AUTOMATICALLY TRANSFERRED TO THE QUEBEC SERIES.
